Behind her are a stone platform with white stone balustrades, two tall white dragon-carved pillars at the left and right edges of the frame, smaller white pillars on the platform, palm trees on the right, a black night sky with purple and blue laser beams, and purple spotlights on the ground.

detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic handheld vertical video, like a real camera filming a live-action scene in the Heavenly Palace at sunset.
[Shot 1] Every frame matches <Video 1> in camera, framing and movement, with <Subject 1> in place of the original woman. She stands with her back to the camera the whole time, so what is seen of her is the back view of <Picture 1>: the chestnut-brown bob ending above her shoulders, never long black hair and never a cap; the gold satin bow standing upright on her head in every frame, also when she lifts the staff above her head; the gold swirl shoulder armour; her bare upper back with the black X straps and the black lacing of the brown corset; the wide brown belt; the dark brown leather shorts; and the brown thigh-high boots with buckled straps on both legs, seen in full whenever her legs are in the frame. She swings, twirls and spins the staff exactly when and how the original woman does, with the same arm movements and steps; only the person and the place have changed. The staff is the same length and moves on exactly the same path as in <Video 1>, held in her gloved hands. When she turns her head a little, her face is the face of <Picture 1>.
The staff is a magic golden-banded staff with visual effects that change over time:
[00:00.00-00:01.10] The staff is not lit at all: a dull dark iron staff with a dark gold band at each end, no glow, no light and no effects on it, as she walks forward holding it slanted down at her side.
[00:01.10-00:01.30] She gives the staff a quick small shake in her hand, and it ignites: bright golden-red light bursts out from her grip and races along the staff to both ends, the gold bands flash brilliantly, and a ring of golden light and sparks pulses outward from the staff, briefly lighting the mist and her back.
[00:01.30-00:09.17] The staff glows brightly for the rest of the video: its whole length shines molten gold and red, with glowing energy flowing along it like liquid light, and the gold bands at both ends burn white-gold. Wisps of white and pale gold immortal mist coil and spiral around the staff and trail behind it. Every swing leaves a glowing golden-red light trail in the air that fades within a moment, and when she spins and twirls it the trails form bright circles and arcs of light around her. Golden sparks and tiny light motes shed from the staff and drift away, and when the staff sweeps low its energy blows the white mist on the road into swirling waves. The effects stay on the staff and around it, follow its movement exactly, and never cover her.

The background is the Heavenly Palace of <Picture 2> in every frame: the warm gold and amber sunset sky with soft clouds, turning grey-violet at the top; the grand palace hall with three tiers of golden-tiled roofs and red columns ahead of her at the top of broad white steps, the tall pagoda behind it on the left and more golden roofs in the haze; the two tall white carved pillars with their soft violet glow at the left and right, and the two smaller pillars further in; the four giant heavenly generals in bronze-gold armour with spears, standing still and watchful at both sides of the road, facing inward, never stepping in front of her; and the pale stone road under low drifting white mist around her feet. The tall carved pillars stand where the two tall white pillars stood, the smaller pillars where the smaller pillars stood, the palace hall and its steps where the stone platform and steps were, the generals at the left and right edges where the edges of the old scene and the palm trees were, the sunset sky and the pagoda where the black sky was, and the misty road where the pebbles were, with the same perspective, and they tilt and slide in the frame exactly as the old background does in <Video 1> when the camera moves; whenever she or the staff covers part of the background, the same part of the new background is covered. No black night sky, no laser beams, no purple spotlights, no palm trees, no pebbles, no candles or red boxes and no bystanders in modern clothes appear at any moment.
The background is alive and moving in every frame, never a still picture: the low white mist rolls and drifts slowly along the road, curling around her boots and swirling away in wisps whenever the staff sweeps low or she steps; thin layers of mist slide past the bases of the pillars and the feet of the generals. In the sky the clouds drift slowly from left to right, their gold and amber edges changing as they pass the sun, and soft sunbeams shift and flicker between them; a few white cranes glide across the sky far behind the palace. The violet glow inside the two tall pillars slowly pulses brighter and dimmer, and its light ripples along the carved dragons. Sunlight shimmers on the golden roof tiles, and the palace lanterns and windows twinkle warmly; tiny golden light motes float up slowly through the air. The heavenly generals are living people, not statues: they breathe, blink and shift their weight slightly, their red helmet plumes and the cloth under their armour stir in the breeze, their hands tighten on their spears, and their eyes and heads turn a little to follow her and the spinning staff, while they stay in their places at the sides of the road. All this movement is calm and natural and never draws the eye away from her.
She is lit by the sunset of <Picture 2>: the low golden sun behind the palace in front of her puts a bright warm rim of gold light along her hair, the bow, the shoulder armour and the edges of her arms and boots, and soft warm light bounced up from the mist and the pale road fills her back, bright enough to see the straps, lacing and leather clearly; the brown leather shows warm golden highlights, the gold armour and bow gleam, and once the staff is lit, its golden-red light moves over her gloves, arms, back and the mist around her as it swings; before it lights up there is no glow from it. She casts a soft shadow toward the camera on the misty road. There is no purple or blue spotlight on her, no black background from the reference picture, and she blends in as if filmed on the spot.
The video has no subtitles, captions, watermark or logo at any moment.

nodes.title: 🚀 五步跑起来
widgets_values:
> 🎯 给一张**人物图**和一段**原视频**，把视频里的人换成你的角色；也能做**动作迁移**。提示词和参数全交给 AI 写进分镜 md，你只要**选分辨率、点运行**。

### ① 🤖 让 AI 写 md
把原视频和人物图发给装了 `feihou-h3-motion-ultra` skill 的 AI（Claude Code、Codex 等），按它的提问选好，它会写出一份**分镜 md**。

### ③ 📄 分镜提示词节点拖入 md
把 md 拖到节点上，或点「选择 md 文件」。以后改了 md，点一下「**刷新提示词**」。

### ④ 📐 Setup 节点只选分辨率
画幅比例、提示词、时长都由 md 决定，不用填。

每跑完一段自动排下一段，全部跑完后「成片」节点输出拼好的完整视频。

widgets_values:
## NPU(昇腾 910B)适配版

已移除整条 **MiniMax H3 Attentions** 子图（两处），模型直通，改用 fork 的昇腾原生注意力。原因：

- `MiniMaxH3MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch`（KJNodes）走 **SageAttention**，仅 CUDA/Triton，昇腾不可用。
- `BlockSparseAttention`（comfy-core, sol-attn）内部 `device.type=='cuda'` 判定，昇腾上自动失效回退 dense，无增益。
- `ModelAttentionBackend='comfy kitchen attention'` 的 INT8 kernel 仅 N 卡/A 卡可用，昇腾上回退 pytorch，不如原生路径。

**仍需在 910B 上确认：**
1. 第二段增强 `FeiHouEasyH3SampleEnhancer2nd` 用的 3D latent upscaler 依赖 `comfy_kitchen` 的 na3d/group_norm 核，昇腾若报错就先把该节点旁路。
2. 模型用的是 `*_int8_convrot.safetensors`（已是昇腾量化格式）。
3. 需装 FeiHou-Easy-H3 节点包与 KJNodes(GetNode/SetNode)。

长视频原本靠 BlockSparse 省显存，昇腾上改为 dense，注意显存/时长。
